messages:
Zara H: Quick heads-up — finished cross-model anchoring canary run for v2 (baseline) vs v2-quant4a-anchor. Putting raw numbers and a short triage here for visibility.

Kevin L: nice — top-line metrics? :eyes:

Zara H: Top-line: 
- traffic: 2% anchor vs 98% baseline (24h)
- latency p95 baseline: 185ms, anchor: 130ms (~30% lower)
- cost token/unit: ~32% reduction for anchor
- rouge_l (long-doc slice): baseline 42.1 -> anchor 41.0 (delta -1.1)
- hallucination rate (knowledge-slice): baseline 2.3% -> anchor 3.1% (delta +0.8%)
- user-sentiment proxy (short Q/A): essentially flat (0.1 pt)

Ben S: <@Zara H> thanks — long-doc rouge drop >1.0 worth flagging. Which slices drove that?

Zara H: Finance long-form and multi-turn instruction summarization had the biggest delta. Short answers / retrieval-augmented slices looked fine.

Carla M: Do we have KV-warmup enabled for the anchor? quant variants sometimes miss warm cache which can affect long-form coherence.

Zara H: It was default (no explicit warm). Good call — I ran a quick shadow with KV-warmup on a 1h subset: rouge_l improved ~0.4 pts and hallucination delta shrank to +0.4%. I'll paste the canary config we used.

Zara H: ```
canary:
  model: v2-quant4a-anchor
  traffic_percent: 2
  warmup_kv: false
  watch_metrics:
    - name: rouge_l_longdoc
      auto_fallback_threshold: -1.0
    - name: hallucination_rate_knowledge
      auto_fallback_threshold: 0.5
    - name: p95_latency_ms
      auto_fallback_multiplier: 1.3
```

Dmitri P: I suggest tightening auto-fallback rules for promotion pipeline: fallback if rouge_l delta <= -1.0 OR hallucination delta >= +0.5 OR p95 > baseline*1.2 for >10m. (1.2 instead of 1.3 because latency gains are nice but not at quality cost).

Ben S: +1 on the hallucination number. Also propose a pre-promote shadow with KV-warmup for 24h at 0% traffic to surface long-tail. If that passes, we can set canary to 1% for 24h then 5% for 6h.

Carla M: Action item: add a targeted sample set (finance-longform, multi-turn summarization) to the oncall watchlist and attach example queries that regressed. Helps SRE/QA reproduce.

ml-ci-bot: smoke-tests: all passed for v2-quant4a-anchor — unit tests and basic eval harness ok. :white_check_mark:

Zara H: deploy-bot kicked off a warm-shadow run with warmup_kv=true per request. <@dmitri> can you watch the 2h window and check hallucination delta?

deploy-bot: warm-shadow deployment started (id: ws-2026-03-21-17). Collecting metrics to /canary/ws-2026-03-21-17.

Dmitri P: Watching. If hallucination delta stays >+0.6 after 2h we auto-roll back to baseline and open rollback ticket.

Ben S: Proposed fallback policy to persist (to be encoded in rollout config):
- auto-fallback if rouge_l_longdoc delta <= -1.0 for any 1h window
- OR hallucination_rate_knowledge delta >= +0.5 for 30m
- OR p95_latency_ms > baseline*1.2 for 15m
- On auto-fallback: immediate traffic cut to 0% for anchor, alert paging list, create incident with tag "canary-auto-fallback"

Carla M: I'll create the ticket and add the failing sample set + notes. Also adding a note to the promotion playbook to always try warm-kv for quant variants before increasing traffic.

Zara H: Summary / next steps:
- keep anchor in warm-shadow for 24h (warmup_kv=true)
- if 24h shadow metrics: rouge_l delta > -1.0 and hallucination delta < +0.5 and p95 within 1.2x -> proceed 1% traffic for 24h, then 5% for 6h
- encode Ben's auto-fallback thresholds into canary config
- ticket: ENG-ml #1428 (Carla creating) with reproducer samples

Kevin L: Sounds good. ping me on the ticket if we need a quick revert script.

Zara H: thanks all — will update after warm-shadow completes. :rocket:
